name: Jarvis
changes_cs: Stary prouzek fronty u vstupu byl odstranen. Cekajici zpravy se ted ovladaji primo pres akcni ikonu u konkretni polozky fronty.
changes_en: The old input queue strip was removed. Waiting messages are now controlled directly from the action icon on each queue item.

history.changes_cs: Stary prouzek fronty u vstupu byl odstranen. Cekajici zpravy se ted ovladaji primo pres akcni ikonu u konkretni polozky fronty.
history.changes_en: The old input queue strip was removed. Waiting messages are now controlled directly from the action icon on each queue item.

history.changes_cs: Fronta prace v chatu ma u kazde cekajici zpravy akcni ikonu. Popup umozni zpravu poslat hned, upravit ji ve vstupu nebo ji smazat z fronty bez psani prikazu.
history.changes_en: The chat work queue now has an action icon for each waiting message. The popup can send it next, edit it in the input, or delete it from the queue without typing commands.

history.changes_cs: Levy seznam projektu a chatu je citelnejsi: projekty maji ikonku slozky a chaty pod projekty jsou odsazene, aby bylo jasne videt hierarchii.
history.changes_en: The left project/chat list is clearer: projects now show a folder icon and chats under projects are indented to make the hierarchy visible.

history.changes_cs: Tooltipy v Jarvisovi se zobrazuji rychleji: vychozi prodleva byla zkracena z 2500 ms na 1000 ms.
history.changes_en: Jarvis tooltips now appear faster: the default delay was reduced from 2500 ms to 1000 ms.

history.changes_cs: Doplnena lokalizace viditelnych ovladacich prvku v Jarvisovi: pridavani podkladu, modely, projekty, soubory projektu, chatove dialogy, automatizace, update a tray uz nepouzivaji pevne ceske popisky. Lokalizacni pamet byla doplnena pro vsechny podporovane jazyky a build Jarvise pouziva /bigobj pro rozsirenou lokalizacni tabulku.
history.changes_en: Localization was added for visible Jarvis controls: adding context, models, projects, project files, chat dialogs, automation, update, and tray no longer use fixed Czech labels. The localization memory was completed for all supported languages and the Jarvis build now uses /bigobj for the expanded localization table.

history.changes_cs: Dialog Noveho projektu je ted nepruhledny a jde presunout tazenim za horni cast. Vychozi cesta pro nove projekty je C:\Jarvis a Jarvis ji pri vytvareni projektu pripravi, kdyz jeste neexistuje.
history.changes_en: The New Project dialog is now opaque and can be moved by dragging the top area. The default location for new projects is C:\Jarvis, and Jarvis prepares it when creating a project if it does not exist yet.

history.changes_cs: Dialog Schopnosti je ted nepruhledny a jde ho presunout tazenim za horni cast okna.
history.changes_en: The Capabilities dialog is now opaque and can be moved by dragging the top area of the window.

history.changes_cs: Automatizace ma novy prehled ve stylu chatu: seznam aktualni prace, fronta a historie jsou v rolovatelnem okne s tichymi akcemi v radcich.
history.changes_en: Automation now uses a chat-style overview: current work, queue, and recent history are shown in a scrollable window with quiet row actions.

history.changes_cs: Menu a podmenu ve WDUi ted automaticky ukazuji tooltip s plnym textem, kdyz se polozka kvuli skinu nebo sirce nevejde.
history.changes_en: WDUi menus and submenus now automatically show a tooltip with the full text when an item is clipped by the current skin or width.

history.changes_cs: Panel Schopnosti je pohyblivy, ma scroll koleckem i posuvnikem a textove zapinani nahradil skinovatelny switch.
history.changes_en: The Capabilities panel can be moved, uses mouse-wheel and scrollbar scrolling, and replaces text enable buttons with a skin-aware switch.

history.changes_cs: Dialog Nastaveni je ted nepruhledny a lze ho presunout tazenim za jeho horni listu.
history.changes_en: The Settings dialog is now opaque and can be moved by dragging its header.

history.changes_cs: Zahlavi okna Jarvise ted zobrazuje ikonku aplikace a nazev ve formatu Jarvis - v<verze>.
history.changes_en: Jarvis window header now shows the app icon and the title in the format Jarvis - v<version>.

history.changes_cs: Prizpusobeni Jarvise: adaptivni profil je nahrazen uzivatelskym profilem, uceni z komunikace funguje jako samostatna volba pro kazdou osobnost a vychozi profilovy text se obnovuje jen po potvrzeni. Prazdny ulozeny profil zustane prazdny.
history.changes_en: Jarvis personalization: Adaptive profile is replaced by User profile, communication learning works as a separate option for every personality, and the default profile text is restored only after confirmation. A saved empty profile stays empty.

history.changes_cs: Prizpusobeni Jarvise: adaptivni profil byl prejmenovan na uzivatelsky profil, uceni z komunikace je samostatna volba pro kazdou osobnost a vychozi text lze obnovit jen po potvrzeni.
history.changes_en: Jarvis personalization: Adaptive profile was renamed to User profile, communication learning is now a separate option for every personality, and restoring the default profile text asks for confirmation before overwriting.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno overovani aktualizace Jarvise: pred instalaci se vynuti cerstvy ADPU manifest, stazeni setupu obchazi cache a pri nesouladu SHA-256 se manifest jednou obnovi a setup znovu stahne.
history.changes_en: Fixed Jarvis self-update verification: the installer now forces a fresh ADPU manifest before install, bypasses cached setup downloads, and retries once with a refreshed manifest if the SHA-256 does not match.

history.changes_cs: Dovednosti v centru schopnosti se zobrazuji podle zvoleneho jazyka UI. Vestaveny katalog dovednosti ma lokalizovane nazvy, popisy, tooltipy, vyhledavani a detail.
history.changes_en: Skills in the capability center now follow the selected UI language. The bundled skill catalog has localized names, descriptions, tooltips, search text, and detail text.

history.changes_cs: Tooltipy v Jarvisovi uz nevyskakuji okamzite; hlavni okno i dialogy pouzivaji prodlevu 2,5 sekundy, aby nerusily pri beznem pohybu mysi.
history.changes_en: Jarvis tooltips no longer appear immediately; the main window and dialogs now use a 2.5 second delay so they do not interrupt normal mouse movement.

history.changes_cs: Frontu prace lze radit pretazenim polozek; Jarvis zpracuje vyse umistene cekajici zadani drive. Seznam fronty ukazuje nekolik polozek a dalsi jde posouvat koleckem i posuvnikem.
history.changes_en: The work queue can be reordered by dragging items; Jarvis processes higher waiting requests earlier. The queue list shows several items and supports mouse-wheel and scrollbar scrolling.

history.changes_cs: Tlacitko Projekt v chatu uz nepridava slozku; otevre vyber existujiciho projektu a priradi k nemu otevreny nebo novy chat.
history.changes_en: The Project action in chat no longer adds a folder; it opens existing projects and assigns the open or new chat to the selected project.

history.changes_cs: Chaty uz nenastavuji globalni projekt; projekt je vlastnost chatu a doplnena lokalizace novych chat/projekt textu.
history.changes_en: Chats no longer set a global current project; the project is chat metadata, with localization completed for the new chat/project text.

history.changes_cs: Chaty uz nenastavuji globalni projekt; projekt je vlastnost chatu a jeho pracovni slozka se obnovi pri nacteni chatu.
history.changes_en: Chats no longer set a global current project; the project is chat metadata and its workspace is restored when that chat is opened.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno spousteni lokalni Ollamy bez rusivych konzolovych oken. Jarvis ma striktnejsi offline lokalizacni pipeline z committovane prekladove pameti; jazyky bez duveryhodneho katalogu se nebudou vydavat za hotovy preklad.
history.changes_en: Fixed local Ollama startup so helper/server processes do not flash console windows. Jarvis now has a stricter offline UI localization pipeline from committed translation memory; languages without a trustworthy complete catalog are not exposed as finished translations.

history.changes_cs: Levy panel Jarvise ma v sekci Projekty scrollovatelny seznam projektu se stromem prirazenych chatu. Kolečko mysi nad sekci Projekty posouva tento seznam a klik na projekt nastavi aktivni projekt, klik na chat nacte chat.
history.changes_en: Jarvis left sidebar now shows Projects as a scrollable project list with assigned chats nested below each project. The mouse wheel scrolls the Projects section, clicking a project makes it active, and clicking a chat loads it.

history.changes_cs: Knihovna modelu je samostatne okno s hierarchickym seznamem podle autora a typu modelu. Tooltip vybraneho modelu nabizi pripravit/stahnout a odinstalovat lokalni Ollama model kvuli mistu na disku.
history.changes_en: The model library is now a separate window with a hierarchical list grouped by model author and model type. The selected model tooltip offers prepare/download and local Ollama uninstall actions for freeing disk space.

history.changes_cs: Projekty v Jarvisovi jsou ted stabilni slozky: existujici projektova cesta se needituje, pridana slozka vytvori novy projekt a chat lze priradit jen k existujicimu projektu nebo k Bez projektu. Sprava chatu uz nema volne editovatelne pole projektove cesty a sidebar/menu umi projekt odebrat z Jarvise bez mazani slozky na disku.
history.changes_en: Jarvis projects are now stable folders: an existing project path is not edited, adding a folder creates a new project, and a chat can be assigned only to an existing project or to No project. Chat management no longer exposes a free-form project path field, and the sidebar/menu can remove a project from Jarvis without deleting the disk folder.

history.changes_cs: Cista instalace Jarvise ted jako vychozi vzhled pouzije Windows 11 Auto, takze se automaticky prizpusobi svetlemu nebo tmavemu rezimu Windows. Rucne ulozene volby vzhledu stavajicich instalaci se nemeni.
history.changes_en: A clean Jarvis install now uses Windows 11 Auto as the default skin, so it follows the Windows light or dark app mode automatically. Existing installations keep their manually saved skin choice.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis je ted v CPM i ADPU pojmenovany jako Jarvis: zdrojovy tool je tools/jarvis, verejny download kanal pouziva apps/jarvis a uzivatelske popisy mluvi o osobnim lokalnim agentovi misto stareho technickeho nazvu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis is now named as Jarvis across CPM and ADPU: the source tool is tools/jarvis, the public download channel uses apps/jarvis, and user-facing descriptions call it a personal local agent instead of the old technical name.

history.changes_cs: Placeholder ve vstupu chatu je ted vyrazne tlumenejsi a mensi, aby bylo jasne, ze jde jen o napovedu a ne o napsany text. WDUi vychozi TextInput placeholder je take ztlumeny pro budouci dialogy a aplikace.
history.changes_en: The chat input placeholder is now more muted and slightly smaller, making it clear that it is a hint and not typed text. The default WDUi TextInput placeholder is also muted for future dialogs and apps.

history.changes_cs: Update dialog Jarvise ted pri dostupne aktualizaci ukazuje kumulativni historii vsech preskocenych verzi. O aplikaci ma nove tlacitko Historie zmen a Napoveda ma primy vstup do stejne historie. Jarvis pred zobrazenim historie preferuje plny update-data.zip se 272 verzemi a kdyz nejde nacist, spadne na kompatibilni update.json.
history.changes_en: Jarvis update dialogs now show cumulative history for every skipped version when an update is available. About now has a Change history button and Help exposes the same history directly. Jarvis prefers the full update-data.zip history before showing release notes, and falls back to compatible update.json when the ZIP detail cannot be loaded.

history.changes_cs: Nastaveni Jarvise uz po kliknuti na Ulozit nezavira dialog. Jazyk a vzhled se meni okamzite jako nahled; kdyz dialog zavres bez ulozeni, Jarvis vrati posledni ulozenou volbu. Dialog Nastaveni je navic nepruhledny, aby pod nim neprosvital chat.
history.changes_en: Jarvis Settings no longer closes after clicking Save. Language and skin changes preview immediately; closing the dialog without saving reverts to the last saved choice. The Settings dialog is now opaque so the chat no longer shows through it.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma zjednoduseny popup Pridat: zustava jen soubor do kontextu, obrazek do zpravy a cil/plan. Duplicitni akce pro novy chat, model, podklady, pracovni slozku a projektovy start jsou pryc, tlacitko Zavrit bylo odstraneno a popup se zavre po vybrani akce, klavesou Esc nebo kliknutim mimo nej.
history.changes_en: Jarvis Add popup has been simplified: it now keeps only file context, image attachment, and goal/plan actions. Duplicate actions for new chat, model, sources, workspace folder, and project start were removed, the Close button was removed, and the popup dismisses after selecting an action, with Esc, or by clicking outside.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma prepsane a sjednocene tooltipy pro beznou praci: chat, frontu, nastaveni, modely, knihovnu modelu a extension manager. Tooltipy jsou ted clenene na kratke radky typu co to udela, kdy to pouzit a co si pohlidat, misto dlouhych technickych odstavcu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis tooltip copy has been rewritten and normalized across everyday work surfaces: chat, queue controls, settings, model selection, the model library, and the extension manager. Tooltips now use short structured lines about what the action does, when to use it, and what to watch for instead of long technical paragraphs.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ted spousti lokalni helper procesy skryteji: Ollama, winget, shell/build/test capture helpery a tichy update setup dostaly explicitni hidden/no-console start flags, aby pri premysleni nebo priprave modelu neblikala cerna konzolova okna.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now starts local helper processes more quietly: Ollama, winget, shell/build/test capture helpers, and the quiet update setup use explicit hidden/no-console launch flags so black console windows no longer flash while Jarvis is thinking or preparing models.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ted u odpovedi, ktere odkazují na nastaveni nebo povoleni, zobrazuje primo v chatove bubline akcni prvky. Z chatu lze otevrit rychle nastaveni pristupu/internetu, modely, projektovou slozku, pracovni nastroje nebo centrum schopnosti bez hledani v menu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now shows inline action controls on replies that refer to settings or permissions. From the chat bubble, users can open quick access/internet settings, model selection, project folder selection, work tools, or the capabilities center without hunting through menus.

history.changes_cs: Chatove okno Jarvise je ted primo kopirovatelne: text v konverzaci jde oznacit mysi, Ctrl+A vybere celou konverzaci a Ctrl+C zkopiruje vyber do schranky. Ikony u bublin dal kopiruji celou zpravu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis chat transcript is now directly copyable: conversation text can be selected with the mouse, Ctrl+A selects the whole transcript, and Ctrl+C copies the selection to the clipboard. Bubble copy icons still copy whole messages.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis uz pri beznem buildu nezkousi nahodne verejne prekladove sluzby. Jazykove UI stavy ted nepouzivaji anglicky fallback jako predstiranou lokalizaci; bez pripraveneho katalogu jsou ostatni jazyky oznacene jako nedolokalizovane.
history.changes_en: Jarvis no longer probes random public translation services during normal builds. Language UI states no longer present English fallback as localization; without a prepared catalog, other languages are marked as not localized.

history.changes_cs: Ikona slozky v sekci Projekty ted prida vybranou existujici slozku jako novy projekt, ulozi ji do seznamu projektu a otevre pro ni cisty chat, misto aby menila cestu stavajiciho projektu.
history.changes_en: The folder icon in Projects now adds the selected existing folder as a new project, stores it in the project list, and opens a clean chat for it instead of changing an existing project's path.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma jasny UI jazykovy fallback: vsechny Windows jazyky jsou vybratelne, bezny chat pouzije zvoleny jazyk a UI pouzije kompletni ceskou nebo anglickou vrstvu misto chybejicich textu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now has an explicit UI language fallback: every Windows language is selectable, ordinary chat follows the selected language, and visible UI text uses a complete Czech or English layer instead of missing strings.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma sjednocene Unicode/UTF-8 ukladani configu, logu a resource metadat, aby cestina a dalsi jazyky prezily restart i update.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now uses a stricter Unicode/UTF-8 text boundary for config, logs, and resource metadata so localized text survives restarts and updates.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma v levem panelu nove Soubory projektu a Slozka. Soubory projektu otevrou vestaveny read-only prohlizec aktualni projektove slozky s nahledem textovych souboru, viditelnym GitHub remote/branch u git checkoutu a bez potreby otevirat webovy prohlizec. Slozka otevre projekt primo ve Windows Exploreru.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now has Project files and Folder actions in the left panel. Project files opens a built-in read-only browser for the current workspace with text-file previews, visible GitHub remote/branch metadata for git checkouts, and no need to open a web browser. Folder opens the project directly in Windows Explorer.
